Method of Attack: Sets autorun in Windows Registry to start automatically on user login
Scans attached hard drives for data files including executables and encrypts them
Does not encrypt files on unmapped network shares but does on mapped network shares
Drops ransom notes (__READ_ME__.txt) with instructions to contact attacker via email
Demands ransom payment in Bitcoins for decryption tool
Slow encryption process allowing potential termination before full encryption
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with attached hard drives and mapped network shares
Attack Vector: Unknown distribution method; infects Windows systems and sets autorun registry key
Indicators of Compromise: Registry entry: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\Adobe Acrobat Optimizer x86 with value "[ransomware_executable].exe" -autorun
